o: Their first meeting transforms an extraordinary space expedition into an unforgettable love story. As they explore strange planets, witness the birth of stars, and uncover secrets hidden within the fabric of time, their love begins to challenge the laws of the universe itself. But their relationship faces an impossible choice: save the woman he loves, preserve the future of an entire civilization, or risk changing the destiny of the cosmos forever. Can love survive across galaxies, dimensions, and time itself? Somewhere among the stars, two souls may discover that love is the most powerful force in the universe.
tag: Across Galaxies. Beyond Time. Forever in Love
